caption: The drawing displays a cross-shaped object comprised of four rectangular sections, each filled with a repeating floral motif that features pink flowers and brown stems with leaves, all set against a green background with linear detailing. The cross itself is bordered and partially overlaid by a decorative grey or silvery outline with regularly spaced dots and scalloped edges, forming an intricate frame that extends outward in a symmetrical pattern, including clover-shaped extensions at both ends of the vertical axis. The background of the image is plain, off-white, and unadorned. The composition centers the cross symmetrically, and the color palette is primarily green, pink, brown, gray, and white.
title: Tin and Painted Glass Cross, Church or Home Use
